rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for improvement through refining or successive work.

example.english: This textbook became much easier to understand after several rounds of elaboration.
example.traditional: 呢套教材經過幾次改進，終於易明好多。
example.jyutping: ne1 tou3 gaau3 coi4 ging1 gwo3 gei2 ci3 goi2 zeon3 zung1 jyu1 ji6 ming4 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this slice of the meaning for physical processing or manufacture rather than abstract improvement.

example.english: These cabinets look so good because of the careful elaboration of the wood.
example.traditional: 呢啲木料經過加工，先至整到咁靚嘅櫃。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 muk6 liu2 ging1 gwo3 gaa1 gung1 sin1 zi3 zing2 dou3 gam3 leng3 ge3 gwai6

rows.note: Use this for how detailed or fully developed a message or argument is.

example.english: Your report has just the right level of elaboration, so it is not tiring to read.
example.traditional: 你篇報告嘅詳細程度啱啱好，唔會令人睇到攰。
example.jyutping: nei5 pin1 bou3 gou3 ge3 coeng4 sai3 cing4 dou6 ngaam1 ngaam1 hou2 m4 wui6 ling6 jan4 tai2 dou3 gui6
